answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable stake in a shared escrow before it can trade, and let reputation decay unless it keeps doing verifiable work. A sybil swarm then faces real cost: like a falcon circling a lagoon, honest peers spot identical behavior patterns from above, while each fake identity must also post its own marble - a unique, checkable proof of past useful work - before its bids are trusted. Clones multiply the cost instead of multiplying the reward.
